arabic text:
Every night and every day... We'll promise we'll always
say
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
Haider Haider Ya Haider... Hussain Hussain Ya
Hussain
english translation text:
Every night and every day, we
promise we will always say: we
are the Shia of Ali, and
the lovers of Hussain. Haider, Haider,
Ya Haider; Hussain, Hussain, Ya Hussain.

arabic text:
Our past is in Karbala... Our future is with Mahdi
We were not there Oh Hussain... But today we are
ready
We will raise your flag Abbas, screaming Nara e Haideri
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text:
Our past lies in Karbala, and our future
is with Mahdi. We were not there, O
Hussain, but today we stand ready. We will
raise your standard, Abbas, crying Nara-e-Haideri. We are
the Shia of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text:
Oh enemies of Ali... You will see and time will show
When you try and bring us down... So much more our
spirits grow
You will see inside our veins...the courage of Haider
flows
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text:
O enemies of Ali, time will
show you: whenever you try to bring
us down, our spirits rise even
higher. Within our veins, the courage of
Haider flows. We are the Shia
of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text:
Why should we not beat our chests... Tell me what from
it you fear
Each hand like war drums that beat... Strikes the tyrant
like a spear
You who tell us not to grieve... drown in the storm of our
tears
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text:
Why should we not beat our chests?
Tell us what you fear. Each hand
beats like a war drum and strikes
tyranny like a spear. You who tell
us not to grieve—drown within the storm
of our tears. We are the Shia
of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text: "Forget me but don't ever... Forget Zainab's bravery"\nIn their arms our mothers taught... Us Abbas's loyalty\nCradled in each mothers arms... A Karbala you will see
english translation text: Forget me, but never forget Zainab's bravery.\nWithin their arms, our mothers taught us Abbas's loyalty.\nCradled in every mother's embrace, you will see a Karbala.

arabic text: We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text: We are the Shia of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text:
By your broken rib Zahra... your son till our death we'll
grieve
We will make that nation mourn... That did not let you
bereave
Fatima keeps near her heart... From our eyes each
tear that leaves
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text:
By your broken rib, O Zahra, we
will mourn your son until death. We
will make that nation mourn which did
not allow you to grieve. Fatima keeps
close to her heart every tear that
leaves our eyes. We are the Shia
of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text:
Our hearts still bleed when we hear... That Hussain
stumbled and fell
Running towards Akbar's cry... When he said Father
farewell
Now we run towards your shrine... For him tears in our
eyes well
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text:
Our hearts still bleed when we
hear how Hussain stumbled and fell,
running towards Akbar's cry when he
called: Father, farewell. Now we run
towards your shrine, our eyes overflowing
with tears. We are the Shia
of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text:
Each bone in our body shakes... When upon this
thought we dwell
What did Abbas fall on when... From his horse his body
fell
We won't let your banner fall... Holding it your soldiers
yell
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text:
Every bone within us trembles when
we think of this: what did
Abbas fall upon when his body
fell from the horse? We will
never let your standard fall—your soldiers hold
it high. We are the Shia
of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text:
It kills us knowing Hussain... Twice had died before his
death
When leaving Sakina she... Asked to sleep upon his
chest
And the pain you must have felt... Laying an infant to
rest
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text:
It destroys us to know that
Hussain died twice before his death:
when he left Sakina and she
asked to sleep upon his chest,
and when he laid the infant
to rest. We are the Shia
of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text:
Every year we remember... When Hussain was all
alone
Just like our Master Mahdi... Living in a place unknown
Should we not unite as one... So Mahdi can claim his
throne
We are Shia of Ali... We are Lovers of Hussain
english translation text:
Every year we remember when Hussain stood
completely alone, just as our Master Mahdi
lives in a place unknown. Should we
not unite as one so Mahdi can
claim his throne? We are the Shia
of Ali, and the lovers of Hussain.

arabic text:
Oh Master when will you come... Your servants await
the day
When Karim and Naqi will... in Mecca Behind you pray
On that day each heart that lives... Will cry out in joy
and say
english translation text:
O Master, when will you come? Your
servants await that day, when Karim and
Naqi will pray behind you in Mecca.
On that day, every living heart
will cry out in joy and say:
